mapper.select: SELECT scope, model_id, label, base_url, api_key, model_name, model_catalog, enabled, temperature, max_tokens, provider_type, capability_protocol, capabilities, reasoning_effort, created_at, updated_at FROM zzl_ai_model_config WHERE scope = #{scope} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, model_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zzl_ai_model_config (scope, model_id, label, base_url, api_key, model_name, model_catalog, enabled, temperature, max_tokens, provider_type, capability_protocol, capabilities, reasoning_effort) VALUES (#{scope}, #{modelId}, COALESCE(#{label}, ''), COALESCE(#{baseUrl}, ''), COALESCE(#{apiKey}, ''), COALESCE(#{modelName}, ''), COALESCE(#{modelCatalog}, '[]'), COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1), COALESCE(#{temperature}, 0.2), COALESCE(#{maxTokens}, 1200), COALESCE(#{providerType}, 'auto'), COALESCE(#{capabilityProtocol}, 'auto'), COALESCE(#{capabilities}, '{}'), COALESCE(#{reasoningEffort}, 'auto')) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label = VALUES(label), base_url = VALUES(base_url), api_key = VALUES(api_key), model_name = VALUES(model_name), model_catalog = VALUES(model_catalog), enabled = VALUES(enabled), temperature = VALUES(temperature), max_tokens = VALUES(max_tokens), provider_type = VALUES(provider_type), capability_protocol = VALUES(capability_protocol), capabilities = VALUES(capabilities), reasoning_effort = VALUES(reasoning_effort), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM zzl_ai_model_config WHERE scope = #{scope} AND model_id = #{modelId}
